name: 2027 Peripheral Nerve Society Annual Meeting
description: The Peripheral Nerve Society Annual Meeting covers research on peripheral neuropathy, with parallel sessions from consortia covering Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, inflammatory neuropathies, inherited neuropathies and related conditions. The meeting is open only to healthcare professionals and researchers, not patients or the general public.
